findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: icx_get_connector_document, recall_epistemic_context · Private data: claim_1m_nodes, icx_get_connector_document, icx_inspect_space, icx_purge_source, icx_quote_slot, icx_recall_scoped, icx_register_connector, icx_remember, icx_reset_session, icx_search_facts, icx_sync_delta · Public sink: icx_register_connector · Destructive: icx_exec, icx_reset_session, icx_wasm_exec.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: icx_get_connector_document, recall_epistemic_context · Private data: claim_1m_nodes, icx_get_connector_document, icx_inspect_space, icx_purge_source, icx_quote_slot, icx_recall_scoped, icx_register_connector, icx_remember, icx_reset_session, icx_search_facts, icx_sync_delta · Public sink: icx_register_connector · Destructive: icx_exec, icx_reset_session, icx_wasm_exec

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
